snippet.title: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream - Official Gameplay Developer Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcas
snippet.description: Watch the Gameplay Developer Overview Trailer for Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream, an action beat-em-up game developed by Gamecom Team. Players will fight across the open world to defeat enemies, attain new weapons, and overcome obstacles in the pursuit of dreams. Hear from the developer on some of the gameplay content and mechanics of Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream, launching in Q3 2025 for PC (Steam).
